capabilities: Fetch RSS feeds and save articles as notes
Template filenames, frontmatter, and note content with variables
Deduplicate imports by scanning the target folder and tracking entries
Auto-delete old notes after a configurable period
Detect YouTube feeds and fetch video thumbnails and duration
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The author states they are not a programmer and that the plugin was built over roughly four months using the tools Claude and Codex. Documentation covers features and template variables but no setup walkthrough or troubleshooting.
motivation: The author states they built Super RSS because it was a tool they needed for their own workflow and decided to share it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull RSS feed items into the vault as notes with controlled filenames, frontmatter, and content.
summary: RSS feed importer that saves feed articles as templated notes in the vault, with deduplication, auto-cleanup, and YouTube feed support.
